changes: Added a gated PLAN->INIT reopen so a maintainer can fix a frozen checklist title that a PLAN scope review flagged. (1) machine.ts + lifecycle-registry.ts: a new REOPEN event and PLAN->INIT backward edge guarded by canReopenToInitGuard (PLAN-only), wired into both the xstate machine and the parallel canSendStoryEventWithoutSnapshotCan switch. (2) transition-orchestrator.ts: maps story_advance phase=INIT from PLAN to REOPEN, requires a >=10-char reason, cwd-gates the reopen to the worktree, and — atomically inside the mkdir persist-claim, co-located with the phase write — resets any done/in_progress checklist item to pending so a reopened requirement cannot stay done with a retitled, code-decoupled definition. (3) worktree.ts: resolveWorktreePath resolves the always-main-relative story.worktree.path against the main repo root (git --git-common-dir) instead of --show-toplevel, so dev_start reuses an existing worktree when run from inside it; plus a storyRel prefix-strip defense and a targeted stale-worktree-registration prune before git worktree add so a deleted-but-registered worktree re-bootstraps cleanly. (4) checklist.ts: corrected the self-contradictory title-freeze refusal message to name the reopen-to-INIT path. (5) a new round-trip smoke plus a dev_start from-main reuse / deleted-worktree re-bootstrap suite.
usage: From inside the story worktree at PLAN: lattice story_advance '{"storyId":"B-x","phase":"INIT","reason":"<why the frozen title must change>"}'. Then edit the title with checklist_update (editable only at INIT), re-run INIT review, and re-advance INIT_CHECK -> PLAN. Omitting the reason, or reopening from a non-PLAN phase, is refused.
expectedOutcome: A maintainer whose PLAN scope review flagged a frozen checklist title can reopen to INIT, fix the title, re-review, and re-advance entirely from inside the worktree, with no git surgery and no hand-edited checklist.json.
actualTranscript:
$ lattice story_advance '{"storyId":"B-x","phase":"INIT","reason":"scope review flagged the frozen title"}'
Story B-x advanced to INIT
$ lattice checklist_update '{"storyId":"B-x","itemId":"CHK-001","title":"<corrected deliverable-naming title>"}'
(title updated)
$ lattice story_advance '{"storyId":"B-x","phase":"INIT_CHECK"}'
Story B-x advanced to INIT_CHECK   (reuses the existing worktree; no 'does not contain .worktrees/...' error)
limitations: The reopen reason is required and validated (>=10 chars) but not yet persisted to a durable audit record, so 'auditable' is aspirational until a follow-up records it (spawned as a follow-up task). The checklist-reset atomicity is concurrency-atomic (mkdir persist-claim + synchronous writes), not crash-transactional. The deleted-worktree prune uses git worktree prune --expire now, which also clears unrelated already-missing registrations (it cannot prune live sibling worktrees). Reopen is PLAN-only; from DEV a maintainer must first roll back to PLAN (REPLAN).
pitfalls: Reopening resets non-pending checklist items to pending on purpose — a changed requirement must re-pass DEV/REVIEW; do not treat that as data loss. dev_start must be run from the worktree's own built CLI (the stale-global-runtime guard blocks the main-checkout CLI from a worktree). The from-main dev_start reuse is byte-identical to before; only the from-inside-the-worktree path changed.
